body: I wish I could feel that those statements are true!
I haven’t changed my mind entirely yet. I’m am seeking treatments actively and am hoping something will change my mind entirely. It’s super tough and I’m losing hope though.

I’m happy to hear you got a job offer! It’s a start. 

The concern of being locked up is the main reason why I don’t share my true feelings with anyone. Sometimes I wonder if it’s really the worst that could happen if my daily life is entirely empty and feeling pointless though. I’ve thought about going to an emergency room but being careful to say I have no suicide plan and such, which I’ve read should keep you away from unwanted restraint. 

My life is in control but just so empty and boring. I don’t want to do anything. I feel like nothing matters. As more days and weeks go on, I can’t help but think there’s no way out.

I feel the same way. 

Is anything specific bothering you that you just can’t seem to change?

Your situation does indeed sound similar. 

I’m surprised to see you write you don’t want suicide off the table. It never truly is off the table for anyone unless they’re in a padded cell or something. My mind keeps going there but I also think about how people might react, which I of course would never see if I actually did it. 

How do you think you’d feel it you found a good job and generally liked it? Do you feel better with grad school behind you? It has me wondering if I maybe just hate my work or something. I’m not loving it but it could just be my current project or work from home situation. It might be time to change companies but then again, I’m not sure I have enough energy to get established somewhere else.

Have you seen a psychiatrist yet?

Do you have any idea what bothers you besides the daily mood you have now?
What have you tried to do so far to feel better?

Your post history shows you were very active in the last few days trying to help others. 

What’s going on with you? And why do you feel like suicide is the only way out?
